legal_units.title: Conversion of an Indian branch of foreign company into subsidiary Indian company.
legal_units.text: Where a foreign company is engaged in the business of banking in India through its branch situated in India and such branch is converted into a subsidiary Indian company as per the scheme framed by the Reserve Bank of India, then, irrespective of anything contained in this Act and subject to the conditions as may be notified by the Central Government,— shall apply with such exceptions, modifications and adaptations as specified in that notification.
